'''''Wookiee Gunner''''' was a [[Vernal-class freighter|''Vernal''-class freighter]] owned and operated by the [[Altisian Jedi]] faction during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was used for humanitarian missions to war-torn [[Planet/Legends|planets]].

Following [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] it served as a covert means of transport for Djinn Altis in his meetings with [[Kal Skirata]].
